tools.name: FileZilla Client
tools.purpose: Upload and synchronise site files with a host over SFTP or FTPS.
tools.verification: Compare the installer's SHA-512 with the checksum published next to the download link.
tools.safe_use: Use SFTP or explicit FTPS only. Never plain FTP. Do not let the client store passwords unless a master password is set.

tools.name: Notepad++
tools.purpose: Edit HTML, CSS, JavaScript and server-side files with syntax highlighting and plugins.
tools.verification: Check the Authenticode signature of the installer and compare its SHA-256 with the release page.
tools.safe_use: Install plugins only through the built-in Plugins Admin, which verifies plugin hashes.

tools.name: HTTrack Website Copier
tools.purpose: Make an offline mirror of a site you own or are authorised to copy, for audits, migrations or archiving.
tools.verification: Prefer the distribution package (apt install httrack) on Linux; on Windows compare the installer hash with the download page.
tools.safe_use: Mirror only sites you own or have written permission to copy. Respect robots.txt and rate-limit the crawl.
